results.title: Mourners in Algeria bid farewell to 10-year-old boy trapped for days in well
results.description: Mourners in Algeria bade farewell to ten-year-old Ayoub Hadaf on Sunday, one day after his body was recovered from a well where he’d been trapped for four days.
